d:
Sundar calls from Ahmedabad to confirm he reached safely and asks Jethalal not to scold Daya. Later, Babita drops by the Gada house to ask Daya about a dinner set, but Jethalal gets held up waiting for bathwater and misses talking to her. Even when he calls Daya later from the shop to congratulate Babita, she has already left.
Step into Jethalal’s world with Gada Electronics! Manage the shop, tackle quirky customers, and experience nonstop TMKOC-style fun.
Are you ready for the challenge?
